name: Deputy
summary: Deputy lists Lite at $5, Core at $6.50 and Pro at $9 per user a month, with a 10% saving on annual billing. Shift swaps and availability are on Lite, auto-scheduling starts on Core and single sign-on is on Pro. Monthly plans carry a $30 minimum monthly spend per invoice.

facts.text: A minimum monthly spend of $30 per invoice applies to monthly Lite, Core and Pro plans.
Deputy states it is SOC 2 Type II compliant and holds ISO 27001 certification, and hosts on AWS in Australia, the UK or the United States.
Deputy Payroll costs $8 per user a month plus a $49 monthly base fee and needs an annual Core or Pro plan in the US.
Managers can choose whether a shift swap needs their approval before it takes effect.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: The page shows one price per plan and a 10% annual saving without listing the annual figure

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Adds auto-scheduling, demand forecasting and wage and labor budgets

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Adds single sign-on, location hierarchies and a sandbox environment

hiddenCosts: Monthly plans have a $30 minimum monthly spend per invoice.
Deputy Payroll adds $8 per user a month plus a $49 monthly base fee.
The HR add-on costs $2 per user a month, and Messaging+ and Analytics+ cost $1.95 and $1.50 per user a month unless on Pro.
